Tiny LLMs/Phi 3.5 mini instruct

Capability lab 3.8B parameters

Phi 3.5 mini instruct

A 3.8-billion-parameter instruction model that reads fluently but breaks format constraints too often to ship.

Evaluated September 8, 2026 · battery v1.

In this article

Verdict.Limits.Results.Reproduction note.

Verdict.

FAIL ○

Only the refusal boundary holds. Summaries add facts, extraction drops fields, code fixes do not run, and the Portuguese probe drifts into English, so no task reaches unsupervised quality.

Limits.

Do not ship for any autonomous task. At most, use it as a supervised brainstorming aid where every fact gets checked against a source.
